zh.cli_description: 记忆管家 V{version} - WorkBuddy 记忆层管理专家
zh.cli_epilog:
命令分组（每个命令均有短别名，如 sum=summarize, rm=clean, tc=token-check）:
  分析诊断 : analyze(stat)  doctor(doc)  scan  report(rep)
  加载检索 : load(get)  search(find)  rank(top)
  上下文工程: selector-audit(sel/sa)  describe(desc)
  写入治理  : govern(gv)  snapshot(snap)  compact(cp)  dashboard(dash)  health(hlt)
  整理瘦身 : clean(rm)  auto-clean(aclean)  archive(ar)  dedup(dd)  cache-clean(cclean)  cache-reminder(crm)
  缓存Token: summarize(sum)  token-check(tc)  token-trends(tt)  throttle(thr)
  Prompt  : prompt-list(pl)  prompt-get(pg)  prompt-save(ps)  prompt-search(psearch)
  维护备份 : backup(bk)  export(exp)  import(imp)  config(cfg)

每日瘦身三连（推荐每日依次执行，保持记忆精简、Token 可控）:
  1) summarize <workspace>                 # 建立摘要缓存，加速后续加载
  2) cache-clean <workspace> --execute      # 清理孤儿摘要 / 过期统计
  3) throttle <workspace>                   # 压预算内精简记忆，注入会话上下文

示例:
  python memory_manager.py analyze /path/to/workspace
  python memory_manager.py load /path/to/workspace --days 7
  python memory_manager.py throttle /workspace

en.cli_epilog:
Command groups (each command has a short alias, e.g. sum=summarize, rm=clean, tc=token-check):
  Analysis    : analyze(stat)  doctor(doc)  scan  report(rep)
  Load/Search : load(get)  search(find)  rank(top)
  Context eng.: selector-audit(sel/sa)  describe(desc)
  Write gov.  : govern(gv)  snapshot(snap)  compact(cp)  dashboard(dash)  health(hlt)
  Cleanup     : clean(rm)  auto-clean(aclean)  archive(ar)  dedup(dd)  cache-clean(cclean)  cache-reminder(crm)
  Cache/Token : summarize(sum)  token-check(tc)  token-trends(tt)  throttle(thr)
  Prompt      : prompt-list(pl)  prompt-get(pg)  prompt-save(ps)  prompt-search(psearch)
  Maintenance : backup(bk)  export(exp)  import(imp)  config(cfg)

Daily slimming trio (run in order each day to keep memory lean and tokens in check):
  1) summarize <workspace>                  # build the summary cache, speed up later loads
  2) cache-clean <workspace> --execute      # clean orphan summaries / expired stats
  3) throttle <workspace>                   # condense memory to fit the budget, inject into the session

Examples:
  python memory_manager.py analyze /path/to/workspace
  python memory_manager.py load /path/to/workspace --days 7
  python memory_manager.py throttle /workspace
